I came to Figma this summer expecting to build software. I didn’t expect to also build a rug, survive a few heat waves, and develop a suspiciously strong attachment to the office snacks. As a Software Engineering Intern on the Desktop team, I built a streaming voice-to-text workflow from scratch, introducing WebSockets into Figma’s infrastructure and AudioWorklets into the Desktop app, both new to Figma. I worked closely with our designer and PM through several rounds of iteration to take the idea from an early prototype to something ready for production. I also built an internal environment configuration modal to make it easier for developers to redirect the Desktop app between environments. But some of my favorite things I built had nothing to do with code. I made my first rug at the very first rug-tufting workshop for interns and their buddies, powered through an NYC food tour in the middle of a heat wave, and joined Figma’s Asian ERG for a Risograph workshop. Somewhere along the way, I also developed a very serious relationship with the office’s strawberry Pocky and 42g Fairlife shakes. More than anything, I’m leaving with a much better understanding of what it means to build something from scratch: not just the technical challenges, but the iteration, collaboration, and people behind it. Huge thank you to my manager Aaron Douglas , my mentor Mark Pleskac , my biggest supporters Nafisa Lenseni , Sam Jaehnig , Prasant Lokinendi , and Somayan Chakrabarti , my Desktop teammates, my intern buddy Lily Yeazell , the most amazing recruiter ever Shell H. , and everyone at Figma who made this summer so memorable. I’m leaving with new skills, new friends, and, most importantly, a rug. Thank you, Figma 💜 #Figma #FigmaIntern #SoftwareEngineering #Internship

Last week, I wrapped up my second Software Engineering internship at Meta in Menlo Park! I had the opportunity to work on the WhatsApp Business CTWA team, where I focused on improving business experiences around data sharing re-engagement. One of the projects I’m most proud of was designing and shipping an exponential backoff re-engagement system for the 3rd-party data sharing opt-in experience across Android and iOS. The new approach replaced a hard two-attempt limit with a widening re-engagement cadence, ultimately driving a 9.8% increase in opt-in rate while maintaining all guardrails. More than anything, this internship taught me a lot about what it means to build and ship at scale. I got to work across Android and iOS, think through experiments and edge cases, collaborate with engineers across the organization, and see projects I worked on make their way into the hands of real users. I’m incredibly grateful to my manager Harshal Dhelia , my project peers Yini Zhuang and Nicolas Gimelli , and everyone at Meta who made this such a memorable summer. Thank you for all the guidance, code reviews, and support along the way!

National Intern Day is one of those moments where both interns and recruiting teams finally get to stop, look around and say: WE DID THAT. 🎉✨👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾 Because behind every internship experience are recruiters, program managers, hiring managers, mentors and countless partners who spent months interviewing, planning, coordinating, onboarding, problem-solving and cheering these students on. And on the other side are interns navigating a new company, new relationships, new expectations and, for many, their very first experience in the working world. National Intern Day at LinkedIn was a MOVIE. 😂🎸 But my favorite part wasn't our interns casually FORMING A BAND 🤯 or our recruiter turning the courtyard into Coachella…. It was getting to spend time together. 💙💐Our Emerging Talent Recruiting team was IRL together for the first time this year, and some of us finally got to meet the interns we've spent months recruiting and rooting for through a virtual screen. There’s something really special about watching the names on your spreadsheets, interview schedules and Slack messages become actual humans building friendships, gaining confidence and making memories together. 🚀✨🥹 To every intern entering the final stretch of your summer: FINISH STRONG. You have so much to be proud of. 🏁🏆🏆🏆 And to my fellow recruiters + early career teams: I know how much work happens behind the scenes to make these programs possible. I hope you’re taking a second to celebrate yourselves, too. 💐💙 Side note… “Linked[in]ternchella” theme next summer?! 👀🎸🤘🏾 I’m just saying. 😂 cc: LinkedIn Life #NationalInternDay #EmergingTalent #EarlyCareers #Internships #Recruiting #LifeAtLinkedIn
